slides.title: A mixed-chip cluster in Seoul
body: AMD says it will build a "reference cluster" in Seoul **next spring**. It is a demonstration site that combines AMD's own CPUs and GPUs with Korean AI chips, AI Times reported.

slides.title: Two Korean chip firms
body: AMD signed an MOU with **FuriosaAI**, which supplies NPUs (neural processing units), and **MangoBoost**, which supplies DPUs (data processing units). Both are Korean.

slides.title: Right chip, right task
body: The three companies will first jointly validate the combined design. The goal is "heterogeneous AI computing": each **inference task** goes to the processor best suited for it.

slides.title: Built in Seoul, not yet
body: The cluster is planned, not built. It is meant to be a real infrastructure setup at **MangoBoost's Seoul facility**. The MOU was signed Nov 4 at AMD's Advancing AI World Tour in Seoul.

slides.title: Korean tech, global chain
body: AMD also plans to work with other Korean companies and research institutes on AI infrastructure. The aim is to explore getting **Korean AI technology** into the global supply chain.

slides.title: AMD is riding the AI boom
body: Same week, AMD reported a record quarter. Heise says server revenue **nearly doubled** and profit roughly doubled, while gaming fell. CEO Lisa Su said revenue beat AMD's own guidance, per Der Standard.

facts.text: "AMD가 자사 CPU·GPU에 국산 AI 반도체를 결합한 이기종 AI 클러스터를 내년 봄 서울에 구축한다." (AMD will build, next spring in Seoul, a heterogeneous AI cluster combining its CPUs and GPUs with domestic AI chips.) Article dated 2026-11-04.

AMD signed an MOU with FuriosaAI and MangoBoost on the 4th at 'AMD Advancing AI World Tour Seoul 2026' (Westin Seoul Parnas hotel) and said it would build a 'reference cluster', a pilot infrastructure for demonstration, in Seoul next spring.
The cluster combines AMD's CPUs and GPUs, FuriosaAI's neural processing unit (NPU) and MangoBoost's data processing unit (DPU) into heterogeneous AI infrastructure.

After joint validation of the combined design, the three companies will implement 'heterogeneous AI computing', which assigns the optimal processor to each inference task, and build it as real infrastructure at MangoBoost's Seoul facility ("구축할 예정", planned).
AMD also plans to cooperate with Korean companies and research institutes on AI infrastructure to explore getting Korean AI technology into the global supply chain.

Heise: in Q3 AMD raised revenue year on year clearly and roughly doubled profit; the server division nearly doubled its revenue ("nahezu verzweifacht"); gaming fell clearly; the share price rose slightly.

Der Standard (German): Lisa Su said on Tuesday, "Wir haben ein Rekordquartal erzielt, in dem der Umsatz unsere Prognose übertroffen hat" (a record quarter in which revenue beat our guidance). Paraphrased in the post.
